title: Hearty Homemade Brazilian Chicken Tagine
description: This dish is a cultured and tender Brazilian recipe, perfect for a sick day, featuring clotted cream and dashi extract, and is gluten free friendly, cooked in a traditional tajine clay vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, and dried thyme.
Heat the coconut oil in the tajine clay vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken to the vessel and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the dashi extract, clotted cream, and chicken broth to the vessel.
Cover the vessel with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
